# Candidate Screening Report

## Candidate: John Doe
John Doe is a graphic design graduate (B.S. in Graphic Design, University of Minnesota, GPA 3.93) with a strong objective to design apparel print for an innovative retail company. He brings approximately 5 years of combined retail and customer-facing experience across brands such as American Eagle, Planet Beach, Heartbreaker, and Victoria's Secret, where he demonstrated skills in sales, merchandising, display setup, and customer service. He also has volunteer brand ambassador experience with Target Corporation. A Dean's List scholar and two-time employee of the month award recipient.

![Profile card](pipelex-storage://7e1058da-ab5f-4cc5-b84a-1ca75a130be7/generated/a90cf200b3341953.png)

## Match Score: 72.0/100
John Doe is a promising candidate for an apparel print design role at a retail company. His academic background in Graphic Design is strong, and his deep retail experience across major apparel brands gives him a unique commercial edge. However, the lack of a verifiable design portfolio or demonstrated design output is a notable concern — it is difficult to assess the quality of his creative work. Recommended next step: request a portfolio review and assess proficiency in design tools (Adobe CC suite) before advancing to interview stage.

## Strengths
<match.strengths>
["B.S. in Graphic Design with high academic achievement (GPA 3.93, Dean's List)", 'Specialized skill in Apparel Print Design — directly aligned with retail apparel design roles', "~5 years of hands-on retail experience across well-known brands (American Eagle, Victoria's Secret, Heartbreaker)", 'Strong blend of design and retail/merchandising knowledge — understands both creative and commercial sides', 'Demonstrated leadership and training ability (Employee of the Month x2)', 'Brand ambassador experience with Target Corporation adds corporate retail exposure', 'Skills in trend awareness and display creation relevant to retail fashion environments']
</match.strengths>

## Gaps
<match.gaps>
['No verified independent online presence or portfolio found to confirm design work quality', 'Limited evidence of professional graphic/apparel design work output (e.g., published collections, freelance clients, or design portfolio)', 'Experience appears weighted more toward retail sales/customer service than hands-on design production', 'No demonstrated proficiency in industry-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop) explicitly listed', 'No evidence of experience with technical apparel specs, CAD, or production-side print design workflows']
</match.gaps>
